findings.area: symbol_door band limit (b - a <= 0.6 + EPS) / real drawing L29-026
findings.summary: The +EPS on the symbol_door wall-band limit moves the real L29 shaft door (L29-026, key L29W-16) 0.30 m off the chord and reports wallThickness 0.6 instead of 0.1. OB.section(...,0.6) clips any mass >= 0.6 m to a band of 0.6 + (distance of its face beyond the chord); here the mass behind the chord is >= 1.0 m thick and the face lies 0.1 mm beyond the chord (b-a = 0.6001). BEFORE/ORIGINAL reject it (0.6001 > 0.6), AFTER accepts it (<= 0.6005). So for a mass thicker than 0.6 m the verdict now flips at 0.5 mm of chord-to-face offset: d <= 0.4 mm inside -> door centred on a 'band' 0.3 m behind the chord; d >= 0.6 mm -> on the chord. The author's note 'a thicker wall is clipped by the 0.6 m window and still read, as before' is only true for a chord on or short of the face. Real-data effect: L29 'ends' score 28/28 -> 27/28 (end error vs key 0.05 m -> 0.25 m, tolerance 0.15), evidence loses 'line work along the opening on another layer'. Not in the author's list; gate figures unchanged because width/class still match.
findings.repro: python -B T/tp_variant_l29.py prints L29-026: before a=[2.5213,-45.6902] t=0.1; after a=[2.2214,-45.6902] t=0.6; AFTER with only that line put back to 'b - a <= 0.6' (T/g_variant) = before. T/regress_before|after/*/score_tower.json pair L29W-16: endErr 0.05 -> 0.25, endsOk true -> false. python -B T/th0_l29_shaft.py shows OB.section at the chord = (-0.6, 0.0014) and wall solid section (-1.0, 0.0014). python -B T/th2_symbol_band.py part 2 (T=1.0 mass, chord d mm inside the face): before flips between d=0.0 and 0.2 mm, after between 0.4 and 0.6 mm. Code: openings.py line 1865.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not let EPS decide the clipped case. Detect a clipped band (a <= -0.6 + 1e-6 or b >= 0.6 - 1e-6, i.e. the wall is thicker than the section window) and treat it one way for every offset (reject it, which restores the BEFORE output for L29-026, or cap t and keep mlat on the chord), and keep '+ EPS' only for unclipped bands. Re-run run7: L29W-16 endErr should return to 0.05.
findings.expected: L29-026 stays on the chord x=2.5213 with wallThickness 0.1 (end error 0.05 m to key)

findings.summary: attached_to_wall measures the wall component with AXIS-ALIGNED bounds (max(x1-x0, y1-y0) >= 0.8, no EPS), so 'a wall of 0.8 m or more' (docstring rule 7) depends on orientation and on float noise. A doorway between two 0.17 m nibs on cross walls (0.2 thick) is kept at 0/17/60/90 deg but dropped at 33 and 45 deg for cross walls 0.81-0.90 m long ((L+t)/sqrt2 < 0.8 at 45 deg); at exactly 0.80 m the verdict is noise (12/40 kept at 0 and 90 deg). BEFORE had no such rule, so doorways against 0.8-0.9 m cross walls at 33-45 deg that BEFORE kept at 0 deg are now angle dependent, and 0.80 m (a common drawn size) is a coin toss.

findings.area: is_free_post (minimum rotated rectangle) thresholds without EPS
findings.summary: `big > 0.9 or small < 0.5 * big` sit on very common drawn sizes (900 mm columns; 1:2 piers 200x400, 250x500, 300x600, 400x800). With the axis-aligned box BEFORE was noise-free at 17/45 deg (rotated 1:2 piers always looked squarish = post); the minimum rotated rectangle has its own rounding noise at every angle, so the post verdict is now decided by sheet position. Free-post verdicts of 40 positions at 0/17/45 deg: 0.25x0.5 before 40/40/40 after 40/20/16; 0.2x0.4 before 35/40/40 after 27/18/30; 0.3x0.6 before 19/40/40 after 17/22/19; 0.4x0.8 before 33/40/40 after 33/13/25; 0.9x0.9 before 8/0/0 after 13/8/5. Consequence: a colonnade of free-standing 1:2 piers (long side across the row, 1.2 m gaps) reports false passages in AFTER at rotated angles where BEFORE reported none: 0.3x0.6 17/45 deg: before 0 in 20/20 placements, after 0..3 per placement (mean 1.1 / 0.6); 0.2x0.4: 0 vs 0..3 (1.3/1.1); 0.4x0.8: 0 vs up to 3 (0.7/1.3); 0.25x0.5: 0 vs up to 2 (0.5/0.6). Also makes the centred-block scenes with a 0.9 m column angle dependent (2 of 252 scenes in tc_centred). The docstring says 'a small piece of any orientation'.
findings.repro: python -B T/tb2_freepost.py (part 1) and python -B T/tb4_pier_rows.py; python -B T/tc_centred.py (INCONSISTENT rows: column c=0.9). Code: openings.py lines 1528-1533.
findings.suggestedFix: Make both comparisons generous: `big > 0.9 + EPS or small < 0.5 * big - EPS`. Optionally skip the MRR when q.bounds already shows the piece cannot be a post (see G7).
